title: A Common Enemy
text: “Aren’t we going to head to the castle and deal with those guys right now?”
Itsuki offered his opinion while still perched on Father, I say.
“I’m raring to go, you know? Those people have gotten way too full of themselves. If we don’t make them pay for it thoroughly right here, my own stomach won’t settle.”
“Itsuki… honestly, you really are…”
“If we’re not going, I’ll just go by myself and wipe them all out. That fine with you?”
“Like I could let you do that. What do you think all this elaborate arranging has been for?”
“I do think it’s a waste of effort, personally. Well, apparently restoring order to this region matters for Emia and the others too, so I’ve been watching how things play out.”
“See, you get it. First we put an end to the conflict with Three Heroes Church, and then it’s only natural to ask Her Majesty to handle restoring order within the country afterward.”
Father explained the plan to Itsuki, indeed.
“Honestly… truly, Itsuki, you’ve gotten just as bloodthirsty as a second Motoyasu-kun.”
“I object to that.”
“I object too, I say! Father!”
Being lumped together with Itsuki like that was a grave error, I tell you!
“You two move at the same speed, that’s the problem. I’d like you both to calm down a little.”
“Nothing to say to that, nano.”
“Hey, you! Quiet down over there!”
Itsuki pointed at Rival, I say.
“Setting Motoyasu-kun and Itsuki aside for now…”
Father turned to face Trash, apparently intending to resume the conversation, indeed.

“Frankly, I’m sick to death of the reputational damage I keep taking because of you, and this happens to be a good opportunity where our interests align, so we’re planning to have Three Heroes Church removed. Ren too, Motoyasu-kun too… Itsuki as well. All the gods together decided on their elimination. For the sake of the world, I want them gone.”
“Ngh…”

Given the circumstances, Trash clenched his fists and glared with a face like he’d bitten into a bitter bug, I say. He was furious that he couldn’t talk back, precisely because he’d ended up at odds with Three Heroes Church.
“The Bow Hero, Sir Kawasumi, is not even present here!”
“Oh? You hadn’t noticed? Well, I suppose I never mentioned it.”
Itsuki answered, still perched atop Father, sounding utterly weary of it all, I say.
“Itsuki… would you mind getting off me and proving you’re actually a hero at some point?”
“Honestly, going back to being human again just seems like a pain at this point…”

Looking thoroughly reluctant, Itsuki climbed down from Father, pulled a cloth out from the bow and draped it over himself, then ordered Rafumi to perform a fairy morph, returning to his original form, and made the bow’s shape shift with a couple of pats, I say.
“This good enough? Change it back quickly, please.”
“Itsuki, when I say ‘back to normal,’ I mean your human form is the normal one, you know?”
“Ha ha, never mind that, hurry up please. This higher-being human form makes me sick to my stomach.”
“Ugh…”
Father let out a sigh as if lamenting the whole situation.
“Wha— guh. Shield! What in the world did you do?!”
Trash, having realized that Itsuki had been disguised as a riska this whole time, and sensing with some certainty that things were quite different from how they’d been before, bellowed, I say.
“I didn’t do anything. If anyone did, it was probably Motoyasu-kun. Also, the cause was this country’s nobles showing Itsuki all sorts of wicked things.”

Father sighed over and over, lamenting, indeed. Beside Éclair, Crocodile Guy, who had been silently watching, nodded along and sighed as well, indeed. The look of contempt directed at Trash was considerable, I say. Meanwhile, Itsuki had returned to riska form and was climbing back up onto Father as if nothing at all had happened.
“Well now… I too got to see quite a lot of things. Unforgivable acts committed against demi-humans and beastmen, and in the end, they even did the same to me.”
“Aultcray, that’s quite enough biting back at the heroes’ change of heart. We’re not getting anywhere at this rate.”
The Queen stepped in, apparently intending to set aside the matter of Itsuki’s transformation for later, indeed.

“Understand now? This was decided by all four Cardinal Heroes together. From what I’ve seen and heard here and there, a hero’s authority seems to carry considerable weight, so it became a unanimous decision to crush Three Heroes Church.”
Itsuki gave a little snicker, flashing an eerie, mocking smile at Trash, I say.
“So that rain of magical attacks back then wasn’t a misunderstanding after all. Fufufufu…”
“Grr… you damned Shield…”
“I really wish people would stop blaming everything on me…”
“Because of that, how many people do you think suffered?”
“Shion, mind your tongue.”
Éclair cautioned Crocodile Guy, I say.
“I understand what you want to say. The king is in the process of taking responsibility for that right now. So please, bear with it.”
“I understand. At this point, it’s gotten so bad it almost starts to look pitiful.”
Éclair furrowed her brow at Crocodile Guy’s words but didn’t press the matter any further, indeed.
“I feel like I truly understand Sir Iwatani’s hardships now.”
So muttered Éclair, watching Itsuki, I say.

“All the misfortune in this world is Naofumi-san’s fault, isn’t it? Pathetic man. Feels like it’d be faster just to kill him already, honestly. Much as I hate to admit it, I agree with Motoyasu-san on this one.”
“Heroes, please…”
“We beg you, please show mercy on that point.”
Éclair and the Queen both put a firm stop to Itsuki’s proposal, indeed.

“Well, since we’ve got a common enemy, let’s just call it a temporary alliance for now, shall we? Besides, you ignored the royal decree to lift my bounty, so for the king’s dignity’s sake alone, someone involved is going to have to face some serious consequences, right?”
“Guh…”
Faced with Father’s response, Trash looked bitterly frustrated, unable to protest any further, but held his tongue, I say.

“That being the case, well… I’ll lend a hand cleaning up the group occupying the castle, quick as we can. If the Queen and the king march into the castle together with all the heroes, led by Ren, who’s the most popular hero around, that ought to make it clear to the citizens who’s in the right.”
“…The country is already in chaos because of Three Heroes Church, so… yes, that sounds right.”
“Hey wait… going by that logic, am I the leader here?! It should be Naofumi! He’s the strongest one of all of us!”
Ren, who had been silent until now, protested to Father in bewilderment, I say.

“I mean, sure, but— it’s safest for Ren, the most popular hero in Melromarc, to take the leader role. Bringing the king and queen along while declaring who’s in the wrong, marching to the castle, saying something like, ‘I have uncovered the truth of this nation! Together with the Queen, I have driven out the heretical group occupying the castle!’”
“Th-that’s— hey!”
Ren turned to Rafumi for help, only to find that she had vanished without a trace, I say.
“Where’d you go?! Rafumi!!”
“No doubt about it, that one’s enjoying herself, nano.”
Rival muttered, watching Rafumi make her escape, I say. And so Ren’s shouting echoed throughout Mole’s burrow, indeed.

And so, with that settled, Fiancée, Filo-tan, and the tiger siblings were sent off via portal to a safe base, and it was decided that we’d hurry to reclaim the castle, bringing along the Queen and Trash. I’d thought Wolf might come along, but apparently, since he was Siltvelt’s hero, having him present would cause problems, indeed. So instead, we were bringing Rabbit Guy along, I say.
“It’s a natural conclusion given how things went, but… are you sure it’s alright for me to come along?”
“I could leave you behind on watch duty, but if Itsuki looks like he’s about to do something, I need someone to stop him.”
“If you think you can stop me, go ahead and try. Fufu.”
“Please don’t ask the impossible…”

Incidentally, since we were technically a hero party, we ended up joining forces with Ren’s companions too, I say. Also, apparently the Queen’s army stationed within the country would be moved in to occupy the castle, and after opening the gates, a large-scale public announcement would be made throughout the castle town. Normally the routine was skirmishing near the border and capturing Three Heroes Church members in the process, but it seemed they were currently occupying the castle itself, indeed.
“Why do I have to be the one doing this…”
Ren’s footsteps were extremely heavy, I say.
“Ren-sama! Let’s do our best!”
“Overcome this, and Ren-sama truly becomes the strongest hero!”
“Quiet, all of you!”
Ren seemed to have grown distant from his old companions from back when he was Inult, and was hiding behind Father while grumbling complaints, I say.
“Ahaha… well, in any case, I should probably keep my face hidden, so let me just throw on this robe.”
Father pulled the robe deep over his head to conceal his face.
